newsitem.title: USA: Tridex stake raised by New York investor.
newsitem.headline: Tridex stake raised by New York investor.

text.p: Jack Silver, a New York investor, said on Tuesday he had raised his stake in Tridex Corp to 270,007 common shares, or 6.76 percent of the total outstanding.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Silver said that in the last 60 days he had bought 82,000 Tridex shares at prices ranging from $10.25 to $12.053 per share.
The stake in the Westport, Conn., company is held for investment purposes, the filing said.

Tridex designs, manufactures, integrates and markets specialized systems and peripheral devices used in the POS, gaming and lottery and financial services and Kiosk markets and other transaction-based applications.
